answer: The wall is Miller oven grind ledger stamped by the grain exchange. Each brick is each oven is a dated grind ticket plus a signed mill log, so a farm must mill 6 real, laid by a different hand, in a different year. The cost lands per alias, not per farm: 429 aliases, 429 proofs, 43329 POA, 5577 minutes, no shortcuts. A farm can print a sparrow, it can fake a forge, but it cannot backdate a zephyr without the archive noticing. An honest agent passes once; a farm pays a hundred times and still fails.
